d: Long, platinum white hair with straight bangs and a side-parted style, paired with golden-yellow eyes in a mischievous expression. An adolescent appearance with a slender build, wearing a white and navy blue maid-inspired outfit featuring a ruffled skirt, a blue striped bow at the neck, and a black waist cinch. White sneakers with red accents and small white bandages on the shins, holding two large black and blue futuristic firearms.
